_howToEdit: One entry per drink. 'variants' lists ONLY the versions actually sold: L1 = Dachi Blend Level 1, L2 = Dachi Blend Level 2, JB = Japan Blend, STD = no blend/level (e.g. Hojicha). The quiz will never recommend a version that is not listed here.

blendNotes.L1: Dachi Blend Level 1: gentle matcha, sweet and creamy.
blendNotes.L2: Dachi Blend Level 2: a stronger, more pronounced matcha taste, still sweet and creamy.
blendNotes.JB: Japan Blend: first-harvest matcha from Izumo, Shimane, from Okumidori and Samidori cultivars. Nutty and umami.
